note: Follow the line. A question, four answers, four verses. People pick how they feel; Scripture answers. Never fortune-telling.

answers.label: worried
answers.text: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

answers.label: tired
answers.text: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

answers.label: alone
answers.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

answers.label: thankful
answers.text: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

answers.label: peace
answers.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

answers.label: strength
answers.text: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.

answers.label: courage
answers.text: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.

answers.label: direction
answers.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.

answers.label: heavy
answers.text: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

answers.label: anxious
answers.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

answers.label: restless
answers.text: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.

answers.label: grateful
answers.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

answers.label: a decision
answers.text: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.

answers.label: a fear
answers.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

answers.label: a long wait
answers.for: if you picked a long wait
answers.text: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.

answers.label: a loss
answers.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

answers.label: work
answers.text: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.

answers.label: family
answers.text: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.

answers.label: money
answers.text: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.

answers.label: tomorrow
answers.text: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
